UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 4, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Naiomi Rainey, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Gina Maguire, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Secretary

Christopher J. Garner, General Manager  Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-51635  Recommendation to approve December 21, 2023 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  23-51636  Approve recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-21-22 for the Rehabilitation
  of Wells Commission 14 and Citizens 10 Project (EO-3553) and authorize the
  General Manager to sign a construction contract with L.O. Lynch Quality Wells &
  Pumps, Inc., in an amount of $4,320,360.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  23-51637  Approve recommendation to authorize revision of the Long Beach Utilities
  Department Rules and Regulations Appendix A and B: LBUD Rate Schedule –
  Charges for Potable Water, Reclaimed Water, and Sewer Service, and
  implementation of a new Water Capacity Impact Fee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CLOSED SESSION

4.  23-51638  Pursuant to Paragraph (b)(1) of Section 54957 and Section 54957.6 of the
  California Government Code regarding Public Employee Performance Evaluation,
  Terms of Employment and Compensation: General Manager

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
